description: Copy the app itself prints: status, connectivity, microphone errors, date field labels. It is separate from the forms because it is shared by all three and is not a question. Every entry needs both languages and the same {placeholders} in each.

file.demoNote.am: በዚህ ሙከራ ውስጥ ፋይሉ አይላክም። ስሙ ብቻ ይታያል።
file.demoNote.en: In this demo the file is not uploaded. Only its name is used.

announce.offline.am: ግንኙነት የለም። መልሶችዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ይቀመጣሉ።
announce.offline.en: You are offline. Your answers are being kept on this device.

offline.body.am: መልሶችዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ ግንኙነት ሲመጣ በራሳቸው ይላካሉ።
offline.body.en: Your answers are kept on this device and will send themselves when the connection returns.

banner.lastSent.en: Your last sign-up was sent. Reference:

resume.title.en: You have an unfinished form. Your answers were restored.

review.intro.am: እነዚህን መልሶች ይሰሙ። ትክክል ካልሆኑ ይቀይሩ።
review.intro.en: Listen to your answers. If something is wrong, change it.

review.nextHint.en: If it is right, press Next.

send.storageFull.am: ይህ መሣሪያ ማስቀመጥ አልቻለም። መልሶችዎ አሁንም በዚህ ገጽ ላይ አሉ። እባክዎ ገጹን አይዝጉ።
send.storageFull.en: This device would not store it. Your answers are still on this page — please do not close it.

send.unreachable.am: አገልጋዩን ማግኘት አልቻልንም። መልሶችዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ተቀምጠዋል እና ግንኙነት ሲመጣ በራሳቸው ይላካሉ። ገጹን መዝጋት ይችላሉ።
send.unreachable.en: We could not reach the server. Your answers are saved on this device and will send themselves when the connection comes back. You can close this page.

send.queued.am: መልሶችዎ በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ተቀምጠዋል። ግንኙነት ሲመጣ በራሳቸው ይላካሉ። ገጹን መዝጋት ይችላሉ።
send.queued.en: Your answers are saved on this device. They will send themselves when the connection returns. You can close this page.

send.rejected.en: The server could not accept these answers.

announce.complete.am: ምዝገባው ተጠናቅቋል። የማጣቀሻ ቁጥርዎ {ref}። ይህን ቁጥር ይያዙት።
announce.complete.en: Sign-up complete. Your reference is {ref}. Keep this number.

voice.noVoice.am: ይህ መሣሪያ በአማርኛ ማንበብ አይችልም። ጽሑፉ ከዚህ በታች አለ።
voice.noVoice.en: This device has no voice for this language. The text is below.

voice.unsupported.am: ድምጽ በዚህ አሳሽ አይሠራም። የስልኩን ማይክሮፎን ይጠቀሙ ወይም ይጻፉ።
voice.unsupported.en: Voice does not work in this browser. Use your keyboard microphone, or type.

voice.pickOne.en: I did not catch that. Pick one:

voice.privacy.am: ድምጽዎ ለግል መረጃ ብቻ ወደዚህ አገልጋይ ይላካል፣ ከዚያ ይሰረዛል።
voice.privacy.en: Your voice is sent to this server only to be written down, then deleted.

voice.buttonsOrType.en: Please use the buttons or type instead.

voice.noEngine.am: በዚህ አገልጋይም የድምጽ መለወጫ አገልግሎት የለም።
voice.noEngine.en: This server also has no transcription service configured, so there is nothing to fall back on.

voice.err.insecure.am: ማይክሮፎኑ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ገጽ ይፈልጋል። ገጹን በhttps ከፍተው እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
voice.err.insecure.en: The microphone needs a secure page. Open this form over https (or on localhost) and try again.

voice.err.framed.am: ማይክሮፎኑ በተካተተው ገጽ ውስጥ ተከልክሏል። ቅጹን በራሱ ትር ከፍተው ይሞክሩ።
voice.err.framed.en: The microphone is blocked inside an embedded frame. Open the form in its own tab and try again.

voice.err.blocked.am: ማይክሮፎኑ ተከልክሏል። በአድራሻ አሞሌው ላይ የማይክሮፎን ፈቃድ ስጡ፣ ከዚያ ይሞክሩ።
voice.err.blocked.en: The microphone is blocked. Allow microphone access for this site in the address bar, then try again.

voice.err.service.am: ይህ ገጽ በድምጽ መስማት እንዲጠቀም አልተፈቀደም። ገጹን በhttps በራሱ ትር ይክፈቱ።
voice.err.service.en: This page is not allowed to use speech recognition — usually a secure-page or embedding restriction. Open the form in its own tab over https.

voice.err.network.am: በድምጽ መስማት የአሳሹ አገልግሎት ግንኙነት ይፈልጋል፣ እሱም አልተገኘም።
voice.err.network.en: Speech recognition needs a connection to the browser's speech service, and it could not be reached.

voice.err.noMic.en: No microphone was found on this device.

voice.err.noModel.en: The browser has no speech model for {langs}.

voice.err.unknown.en: Speech input did not start on this device.

sent.supportHidden.am: የእርዳታ መልሶች በዚህ ዝርዝር ውስጥ የሉም።
sent.supportHidden.en: The support answers are not in this payload — they never left the phone.
